📌 Private Order Flow: Hiding a Trade Before Execution

Main Points
⏺ In a public mempool, other participants can see your transaction before confirmation
⏺ Private routing can hide an order from some bots and front-running strategies
⏺ This post explains why execution privacy matters for larger trades

1️⃣ Core Idea — a transaction is sent through a private channel or specialized executor instead of the public flow.
2️⃣ Why It Matters — it becomes harder for others to see your order early and jump ahead.
3️⃣ Where It Helps — large swaps, arbitrage, DeFi trades, and situations where price can worsen because of other actors.
4️⃣ Risk Surface — you now depend on a new execution route and its rules.
5️⃣ Practical Rule — understand who receives your transaction, how it is executed, and what guarantees the service provides.

Final Thoughts

Private order flow does not make execution perfect, but it can reduce the damage from public visibility. In crypto, it matters not only what you trade, but who sees it before it lands.

Jerusalem’s Two Landlords

Erdoğan says Jerusalem is “our city.” Netanyahu says: “No, sir, you won’t. It is our city.” The city itself has heard this real-estate pitch before, usually from men whose armies are elsewhere.

Turkey’s claim is Ottoman nostalgia with an aid budget. Erdoğan invokes four centuries of Ottoman rule, Suleiman the Magnificent and Al-Aqsa as a Muslim symbol. 

Ankara then funds restorations, schools and Palestinian institutions through TİKA, its state development agency. Turkey repairs a dome, finances a dormitory and calls it heritage. In Jerusalem, a renovated window can be a foreign-policy office.

Jordan owns the paperwork Ankara lacks. Article 9 of the 1994 Israel-Jordan peace treaty recognizes the Hashemite Kingdom’s “special role” in Jerusalem’s Muslim holy shrines. 

King Abdullah’s custodianship is also anchored in the 2013 agreement with Mahmoud Abbas. The Jordanian-linked Waqf administers the Islamic compound. 

Even TİKA had to negotiate with Jordanian authorities when it wanted to renovate the Islamic Museum beside Al-Aqsa.

That is the collision. Turkey wants the microphone. Jordan has the keys. Israel controls security and access around the Temple Mount. Palestinians claim East Jerusalem as the capital of their future state. Each side has a title, a treaty, a police checkpoint or a restoration invoice. None has the whole building.

Erdoğan’s Jerusalem policy is not about acquiring a formal custodianship tomorrow. 

It is about making Turkey impossible to ignore when Al-Aqsa is discussed. Jordan’s role blocks Turkey from becoming the official guardian. Turkish money works around that barrier by turning influence into a parallel form of presence.

Netanyahu tells Erdoğan that Jerusalem is Israel’s city. Erdoğan answers with Ottoman ghosts. Jordan quietly points to Article 9. At Al-Aqsa, the loudest claimant is rarely the one holding the paperwork.

🔔 South Korea targets November review for second stage crypto legislation 

🌐 South Korea’s Financial Services Commission has set November for a National Assembly subcommittee review of the Digital Asset Framework Act, rejecting claims that work on the country’s second stage crypto legislation has been delayed. According to Seo Na yoon, head of the FSC’s virtual asset division, the regulator and lawmakers are moving in the same direction on legislation covering digital asset issuance and distribution, including stablecoins. Speaking at a National Assembly seminar in Seoul on Sept. 22, Seo said differences remain over when the government will submit its draft, but the November review remains part of the planned timetable. 

⚡️ “The FSC is not dragging its feet at all. We share the same view,” Seo said, responding to criticism over the pace of the legislation. “The direction has already been set, and while detailed discussions may be necessary in the process, there is certainly no intention on the FSC’s part to delay.”

🔗 Seo said the regulator wants the legislation passed quickly and expects discussions to proceed using bills that lawmakers have already introduced alongside the government’s proposal. Ten digital asset and stablecoin bills are currently pending in the National Assembly, giving lawmakers existing proposals to work from before the government completes its version.

📢 IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT WITHDRAWALS

Dear METATRONICS participants!

Due to changes in transfer addresses, blocking, and additional AML checks, please carefully consider the following recommendations when submitting withdrawal requests.

1️⃣ Avoid making multiple withdrawals within a short period

We recommend planning withdrawals to your own address once a week, instead of submitting several small requests in succession. This simplifies transaction monitoring and the reconciliation of incoming funds, while also reducing the number of separate operations and the associated fees.

This is a recommendation for organising withdrawals, not a way to avoid AML checks.

2️⃣ Use the BEP-20 network whenever possible

If your wallet or exchange supports receiving the selected asset via BEP-20, we recommend choosing this network for withdrawals.

Before confirming, always check the network on the recipient’s side: it must match the network specified in the withdrawal request. Selecting the wrong network may result in difficulties with crediting or the loss of funds. Choosing BEP-20 does not exempt a transaction from checks.

3️⃣ Withdraw funds only to your own wallets

Do not use third-party addresses, questionable intermediaries, or addresses whose origin and transaction history are unknown to you.

Using your own wallet allows you to maintain control over your funds and, if necessary, confirm ownership of the address. Addresses flagged as suspicious by services may result in additional checks or restrictions.

🔐 Before every withdrawal request, verify the address, selected network, and whether the recipient supports the asset. If a transaction is under review, keep its details and contact the official support team of the service conducting the review.

Thank you for your attention and responsible approach to the security of your funds!
